resources.string: Use both together: Kavach blocks your other selected apps. YouTube Focus manages channels and Shorts, so YouTube stays out of Kavach’s block list.
Turn on the YouTube Focus accessibility permission before enabling protection.
YouTube Focus could not connect. Check its accessibility permission and try again.
Could not enable YouTube Focus. Please try again.
Could not update YouTube’s blocking setting. Your previous choice has been kept. Try again.
Kavach can still block your other apps. Tap to see options.
Channel and Shorts protection stays on.
Both can stay on together. Kavach blocks your other selected apps; YouTube Focus manages channels and Shorts. Blocking the entire YouTube app in Kavach stops lessons too.
To block all of YouTube, turn off YouTube Focus and select YouTube for Kavach. YouTube will be blocked when Kavach is active.
Other apps are selected. YouTube stays managed by YouTube Focus.
